summary: SLM Student Loan Trust 2006-7 filed an 8-K reporting an affiliate of Navient Funding (the depositor) will submit hold orders and buy bids at future auctions for two classes of auction-rate notes (Class A-6B and A-6C). The affiliate already holds all issued Class A-6B notes ($28.55M) and most Class A-6C notes ($28.5M). For the June 24, 2026 A-6B auction, it will hold; for A-6C on June 26, it will bid for outstanding notes at SOFR+1.50%. This is a routine auction-rate securities notice, not a transformative special situation. No price, premium, or strategic transaction is disclosed.
